name: Bird-Dog Hold

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: McGill Spine Low Back Stabilization Protocol

steps: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position, with wrists directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Brace your core gently to maintain a neutral spine, as if balancing a cup of water on your lower back.
Slowly extend your right arm straight forward and your left leg straight backward until both are parallel to the floor.
Hold this position for 3 to 5 seconds, actively reaching through your fingertips and pushing through your back heel without rotating your hips.
Return smoothly to tabletop and repeat on the opposite side (left arm and right leg).
coaching_cues: Do not raise your arm or leg higher than your torso; avoid sagging or arching your lower back.
Keep your hips square to the floor throughout the entire movement.
Breathe smoothly and maintain consistent core abdominal pressure.

sources.attribution: Dr. Stuart McGill Low Back Disorders Clinical Protocol
